title: Vampire Vape Heisenberg 70/30 E-Liquid
description: Heisenberg by Vampire Vape is a renowned award-winning e-liquid that features a fruity blend of mixed red berries, topped off with a refreshing menthol breeze. Enjoy the icy cool crystal kick, as the intense flavours of ripe fruits burst through. The fruit to menthol ratio is expertly balanced, making this e-liquid an ideal choice for easy all-day vaping. This premium e-liquid from Vampire Vape comes in a 70% VG / 30% PG ratio which makes it ideal for sub-ohm vaping. The higher quantity of VG (vegetable glycerin) provides a gentle, comfortable throat hit and increased vapour production, while the PG (propylene glycol) ensures a flavoursome vape every time. This e-liquid is perfect for use with high-powered vape kits with low-resistance, ‘sub-ohm’ coils. 10ml bottles of e-liquid remain one of the most popular and versatile ways to enjoy vaping. Each bottle is capable of filling a 2ml pod or tank five times, which makes them far more sustainable and economic than single-use, disposable vapes. Their affordability makes them ideal for experimenting with and changing flavours on the fly, and their compact form makes 10ml bottles easy to carry alongside your preferred vape device. Vampire Vape are one of the most successful and influential e-liquid brands in the UK. They are renowned for the quality and variety of their e-liquids and for their signature flavours, including game-changing e-liquid icons Heisenberg & Pinkman flavours.
